## QF-MVP-50.7 — STALE-BUSINESS SUPERVISOR (SELF-HOSTED STAGING CANDIDATE)

**KEEP INACTIVE / UNPUBLISHED.**

Default path is fail-closed because `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED` must equal `true`.

Secrets are runtime env references only; never paste secret values into this workflow.

Required later on self-hosted n8n: `QF_CORE_STAGING_BASE_URL`, `QF_N8N_WORKER_ID`, `QF_N8N_TO_CORE_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_CORE_TO_N8N_HMAC_SECRET`, `QF_N8N_TRANSPORT_ENABLED`. **No new variable is introduced by 50.6.**

### WHY A FOURTH LANE

Fresh `pending` work belongs to the certified client/vendor/campaign executors. Due retries belong to the 50.5 `recover` lane. Stale in-flight attempts belong to the 50.5 `reconcile` lane. None of those three can ever remove a job whose business entity has been deleted: claim keeps offering it, recovery keeps rescheduling it, and every executor that picks it up fails to resolve a recipient.

This lane is the fourth class of work — jobs that must LEAVE the executable set — and it gets its own schedule trigger and its own n8n execution so it can never starve, or be starved by, the other three.

One unit of work per cycle, every 5 minutes. A standing backlog drains steadily and the lane then answers `cancel_stale_empty` indefinitely, which is the intended resting state.

### n8n OWNS NO BUSINESS AUTHORITY HERE

It sends three identity fields and nothing else. It never chooses the job, the entity, the reason or the moment. It cannot ask for a specific job to be cancelled, because the Core parser rejects any body that carries a fourth key — a property visible in `lib/automation/staleBusinessContract.ts`, not merely asserted here.

It holds no Supabase credential, queries no table, calls no Meta endpoint and sends no message. It decides nothing about staleness; Core proves the entity still EXISTS and that current business truth is stale, inside the same transaction that writes the terminalization — and re-proves it after the write.

### WHAT THIS WORKFLOW CANNOT DO

It cannot reach any Core route but `/api/internal/automation/n8n/cancel-stale` — the allowed-path set in the POST node holds exactly one entry. It cannot claim, execute, complete, recover or reconcile. It cannot open an attempt or consume an attempt budget: the transport shape constraint requires `attempt_id`, `attempt_number` and `max_attempts` to be null on this route. It cannot cancel a `processing` job, a terminal job, or a job whose entity still exists. It cannot delete automation history — `cancelled` is a terminal state, and every job, action and attempt row is preserved.

Every outcome of this graph is a STOP. Nothing is ever forwarded.

The certified QF-MVP-50.2E / 50.3 / 50.4 / 50.5 workflows are NOT modified by this phase.
